build_coins_substrate: build the coins substrate given player roles and a config dict with map dimensions
create_config: create the default configuration for the Coins substrate with map size and action set
create_prefabs: create a dictionary of prefab game objects including wall, spawn point, and coin with reward settings
create_coin_prefab: create a coin prefab config with two coin types, regrow rate, and match/mismatch rewards
create_avatar: create an avatar game object with movement actions, coin type, and partner tracking
